claim: The capstone: Vera's posture is explainable to a buyer / security reviewer WITHOUT Lamar in the room. READY only when every hardening cert passes (security_baseline, permissions, privacy, performance, ai_security, product_polish) AND the evidence exists: the live-path audit matrix has 0 wallpaper/stub/unreachable/regressed/unknown with the only PARTIAL honestly external-dependency-blocked; the security evidence is written down (security_architecture + threat_model + permission_model); and the diamond baseline reports exist so a reviewer can read the posture cold. This is an AGGREGATE meta-cert — it cannot be green while any hardening cert is red or the audit has a hidden gap.
owner: scripts/enterprise_readiness.py (runs every hardening cert + checks the clean audit matrix + docs + diamond reports), the per-phase certs it aggregates, docs/, reports/

killer_test.name: all_hardening_green_audit_clean_evidence_present
killer_test.setup: scripts/enterprise_readiness.py runs the 6 hardening certs (security/permissions/privacy/performance/ai-security/polish) and requires all CERTIFIED; requires the audit matrix to have 0 hard-gaps with partials external-blocked only; requires the security docs (architecture/threat-model/permission-model) and the diamond baseline reports to exist. READY only when all hold.

known_gaps: Formal compliance artifacts (SOC 2 / ISO control mappings, a signed DPA, a vendor security questionnaire) are GRC paperwork beyond this technical readiness gate; this cert proves the engineering posture is sound, certified, and documented — the foundation those artifacts would attest to.
